summary: The probe role summaries now use the same Cerebras projection as dispatch, with a regression test confirming the recorded native roles match the actual wire roles.

evidence: src/harmony/probes.ts derives built, raw, and classifier role summaries through projectedMessageRoles.
projectedMessageRoles calls the exported projectCerebrasRequest used by the Cerebras transport, so developer-to-system mapping and system collapsing are reflected in recorded roles.
tests/harmony-probes.test.ts verifies that a native probe records the same ["system", "user"] roles observed by the real Cerebras transport wrapper.
